text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are moving in lockstep with nearly identical 24-hour gains, suggesting broad-based strength rather than rotation between them. The Fear & Greed index climbing to 70 with a 13-point weekly jump indicates accelerating optimism, while BTC dominance holding steady near 59% shows investors are comfortable taking risk across altcoins alongside the majors. Volume at $124B reflects meaningful conviction behind the move rather than thin liquidity.
